enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering, brushing teeth and getting ready for work
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Wash hands. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse body and hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply deodorant. Put on work clothes. Turn off bathroom light.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Take out frying pan. Turn on induction cooker. Crack eggs. Whisk eggs. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Put bread in toaster. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up and put dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open front door. Walk out. Lock front door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital ward. Put on scrubs and PPE. Attend handover meeting. Review patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Check vital signs. Administer medications. Assist patients with mobility. Change wound dressings. Monitor IV drips. Communicate with doctors. Update patient records. Respond to call bells. Assist with patient hygiene. Collect specimens. Coordinate with nurses. Attend to emergencies. Take lunch break. Return to ward. Continue patient care.
Leave hospital. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Approach front door. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Take off work clothes. Place clothes in hamper. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse body and hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Put on casual clothes. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Cook dinner. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table and eat dinner. Stand up and put dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Put remote on table. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Lean back on sofa. Watch TV. Change posture. Pick up remote again. Change channel. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes, cleaning up the kitchen and packing lunch for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open dishwasher. Load dishes. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Sweep floor. Take out lunch box. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients for lunch. Close refrigerator. Prepare sandwich. Place sandwich in lunch box. Add fruit. Close lunch box. Place lunch box in refrigerator. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal browsing and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open web browser. Browse website. Check email. Scroll through social media. Click on video. Watch video. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Use computer. Turn off computer. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Night-time routine, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Pat dry with towel. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit in sink. Wipe mouth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and checking phone in bed to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Pick up phone. Check messages. Scroll through phone. Put phone down. Continue reading. Close book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.
Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Bend knees. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arm. Turn to back. Remain still.
